adjustments.action: Increase healthcare cap — defensive with strong 6M momentum
adjustments.rationale: Healthcare is RADAR-favored with +28.3% 6M momentum, low beta (0.47), and provides GDP-decoupled earnings in a stagflationary environment.

adjustments.rationale: PCE at 3.65% with breakevens at 2.29% means TIPS are mispriced cheap; HY spreads widening (348bps, trend widening) with HYG -0.26% today signals credit deterioration — avoid.

adjustments.action: Raise tactical cash — VIX rising, S&P -2.7% today, regime transition risk
adjustments.rationale: Today's 2.7% S&P selloff with rising VIX and widening HY spreads suggests further downside; cash provides optionality to buy the dip if VIX spikes above 30.

bond_strategy.regime_summary: Short-duration TIPS and treasuries only; avoid all credit risk as HY spreads widen and stagflation compresses corporate margins.

cash_allocation.rationale: VIX at 22 and rising with S&P -2.7% intraday warrants elevated cash as a call option on further volatility; stagflation regimes feature episodic selloffs that reward patient capital deployment.

crypto_allocation.rationale: Crypto is a risk asset that correlates with liquidity; with Fed on hold, real rates positive, and VIX rising, reduce crypto exposure but maintain small Agressif allocation as digital gold thesis partially holds.

warnings: CRITICAL: All portfolios at 0% bonds and 80-85% equity — this is a pure equity portfolio masquerading as diversified; immediate rebalancing needed regardless of regime view.
